meta.title: Update notifier
meta.description: Checks installed plugins for newer releases every 24 hours and keeps a badge in the bottom-right corner: it shows the count when something is out of date, and a green check mark when everything is current. Open the badge to see the version jump for each plugin, then update them one at a time or all at once. Nothing is installed until you confirm. Turn it off and the badge stops appearing and no release checks run.
